name: nervouscsstem
description: NERV Design System — pure-CSS design system inspired by Neon Genesis Evangelion operational consoles
author: Texarkanine <texarkanine@protonmail.com>

scripts.build: sass src/nerv.scss dist/nerv.css --no-source-map && cp src/nerv.js dist/nerv.js
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/foundation.test.mjs test/effects.test.mjs test/panels.test.mjs test/patterns.test.mjs test/components.test.mjs test/states.test.mjs test/publish-contract.test.mjs
